protocol.criterion: Run complete heuristic source-to-report workflow on English text retained in the multilingual suite. Report parser coverage and abstention, package replay and runtime; no external semantic/factual gold is constructed. Do not tune grammar after outcomes.
protocol.reference_use: Do not equate FraCaS inference labels with gold atom mappings. No NLI accuracy metric without a faithful formalization oracle.
protocol.prior_exposure: Public dataset; analyst inspected metadata and first XML examples. No unseen claim.
protocol.raw_redistribution: No raw dataset redistributed: source-repository license not found; source identity and hashes supplied for retrieval.

summary.meaning: Coverage-only distribution shift; exact copied text does not independently validate interpretation. Outcomes did not drive grammar edits.
